title: Late Breaking Results: Source-Aware Adaptive Cache Management for CXL-enabled Disaggregated Memory Sharing
problem: CXL-enabled disaggregated memory systems with multiple hosts exhibit changing access patterns; conventional cache policies cannot track per-host behavior, making it difficult to optimize shared memory efficiency.
motivation: CXL enables memory disaggregation across hosts, but dynamic multi-source workloads require adaptive cache management that understands individual host contributions and access patterns.
method: Alchemy system jointly optimizes cache replacement and bypassing policies using reinforcement learning with source-aware adaptivity. It runs as an online RL agent that tracks per-host access patterns. Rewards derive from sampling-based action effectiveness and per-host macro-level performance metrics.
key_novelty: First source-aware RL-based adaptive cache management for CXL disaggregated memory, jointly optimizing replacement and bypassing with per-host behavior awareness.
contributions: Source-aware adaptive cache management via online reinforcement learning
Joint optimization of cache replacement and bypassing policies
Sampling-based reward derivation from action effectiveness and per-host performance
8.71%-14.56% average access latency reduction vs. LRU
44× faster decision-making than hardware-efficient ICGMM with comparable overhead

metrics.other: 8.71%-14.56% access latency reduction, 44× faster than ICGMM
